_doc: Songs of the Musik minigame (story 4.6), original chiptune-style patterns. lanes: note lanes (4, left to right: left, down, up, right). stepsPerBar: grid steps per bar (8 = eighth notes of a 4/4 bar). play: leadInMs = silence before the first note, tailMs = no note is scheduled this close to the end. windows: hit window half-widths in ms (perfect, good) and lingerMs = how long a missed note keeps sliding past the line; tiers scale them (windowScale > 1 = more forgiving) and set how long a note falls from the top to the hit line (fallMs). tierRule: the chart tier follows difficulty + levelStep * (player level - 1): medium from mediumFrom, hard from hardFrom. scoring: points per hit, a combo multiplier that grows by multStep every comboStep hits up to maxMult, both multiplied by (1 + the character's musicArtBonus perk); the perk also widens the windows by the same share. A song is one loop of bars per tier (charts[tier][bar] = string of stepsPerBar chars, '.' rest or the lane digit, singles only); the schedule repeats the loop to fill the round and mirrors the lanes on every second pass. bpm drives the beat cue; root + scale[lane] are MIDI pitches the audio epic can play for a hit (music:note carries them).
